title: Tail Flick Test Protocol
author: Eva Feldman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7thhnj6
materials: Setup: − Must clean equipment with sporeklenz before entering the animal room − All restrainers need to be exclusively used in same room. If restrainer has been in another animal room, it CANNOT be used! − Never remove cable from test head or back of tail flick machine when it is on. Failure to pay attention may damage electrical circuits in machine.

steps.title: Acclimate Mice to Machine
steps.instruction: Acclimate the mice to the machine by placing each mouse in the restrainer briefly 2-3 times before the test occurs.

steps.title: Prepare Mouse Tail
steps.instruction: Measure and mark the mouse tail 3 cm from the tip.

steps.title: Configure Instrument Settings
steps.instruction: Set the instrument parameters using the keyboard commands (number + E).

substeps.instruction: Place temp sensor on the groove in ready state if needed
For the first animal, enter the following sequences: 6000E (disables pre-warm), 4001E, 3025E, and 5010E
Set the time of day (5 digit sequence, 24 hr format, e.g., 00100E for 1am)
Set the date (6 digits, e.g., 020501 for Feb 5th, 2001)

steps.title: Position Mouse in Restrainer
steps.instruction: Place the mouse in the restrainer with the head facing towards the keypad.

substeps.instruction: Align the previously made tail mark over the pinhole opening
Ensure the tail is kept as close to the groove as possible

steps.title: Execute Tail Flick Test
steps.instruction: Start the test using either the footswitch or the red button.

substeps.instruction: Press the footswitch or red button once to arm the system
Press it a second time to start the test
Allow the temperature to ramp up to the desired temperature; the test will begin and end automatically
The machine will shut off once the mouse moves its tail

steps.title: Record Test Results
steps.instruction: Observe the three flashing numbers displayed after the test ends.
